about_the_game:
Symmetrical Move is a minimalist puzzle game about control, balance, and perspective.

You guide two pieces that move in perfect symmetry. Every step you take is mirrored, every mistake doubled. What feels simple at first quickly grows into a brain-bending challenge as obstacles, walls, and goals demand careful planning.

🟩 Features:
• 100 handcrafted puzzles built around mirrored movement
• A clean, uncluttered design that puts focus on problem-solving
• Gradually increasing complexity — from relaxing to truly mind-twisting
• Quick restarts for experimentation and learning

Whether you have a few minutes or an hour, Symmetrical Move offers a focused puzzle experience for players who enjoy logic, order, and a touch of symmetry.
